effect.shortEffect: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.
effect.full: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

french.ttm: La première fois que le Pokémon entre au combat,\nune odeur de nectar sucré se répand sur le terrain,\nce qui baisse l’Esquive de l’adversaire.

english.ttm: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

japanese.ttm: 最初に　登場　したとき 甘ったるい　蜜の香りを　ふりまいて 相手の　回避率を　下げる。
